_comment: GENERATED by npm run og:covers. slug -> what each twin was made from, so a stale twin can be told from a fresh one: `ground` digests the cover file and the type over it (checked by CoverAssetTests), `style` names the house style it was set in, and `css` digests the composition they were drawn with (both checked by coverOgManifest.test.ts). `script`, `art`, `scrim` and `fonts` are the rest of what a card is made from, read back by the skip so a change to any of them redraws.
